scope: Original synthetic mapper, identity, isolation and recipe fixtures. Supplied-ROM evidence is separate.

results.name: MMC2 uses selected 8 KiB PRG plus the final fixed 24 KiB
Both CHR halves retain independent FD and FE banks with documented latch ranges
Mirroring and physical layout bounds refuse invalid mappings
Live PPU returns the old bank byte before applying the latch and preserves original headers
Existing mappers delegate to the exact prior reader and no schema owner changes
MMC2 isolated audio requires explicit opt-in and cannot touch mapper or PPU buses
Both native profiles expose exactly 711 writable literal bytes without asset payloads
Synthetic filename-like content and caller hashes do not authorize commercial profiles
Native recipes enforce unique writable physical operands and protect latch-control tile IDs
Malformed PPU programs refuse under bounded source reads
Empty native requests and stop controls refuse before isolated execution
New audio profiles declare 8 KiB physical windows and read-only methods
Resumable native routines preserve instruction timing, DAC writes and the single return
Continuous routine windows keep instruction and bus refusal limits
PCM audition never silently converts its bell into an editable substitute
